description: Corrected positive counterpart to context-integrity-v045-failed-run, for the same run identity, target repository, active index, and request shape. Derived from the real failed-run producer capsule/audit (same owners, same 39-of-47 retained contract witnesses, same real evidence-group data) with the exact v1.10.4 condition-aware corrections applied: roleConditionCoverage added (both conditions satisfied because the retained witness counts already exceed the minimum of one), requiredOmittedCount corrected to 0 for the two previously-affected groups (their omissions reclassified as optional-only, matching the real retained/available counts), and roleAdequacy/truncation updated to the resulting 'sufficient with assumptions' / requiredEvidenceLost:false state. Follows the same hand-distillation convention already used by my-dev-kit-orchestrator's own tests/fixtures/v123-batch4/corrected-run fixture (commit 2cb82f0) rather than a live 10-stage AI-authored replay, since redoing the actual Android feature implementation is outside safe/bounded batch scope; see derived/run-integrity-evidence.json's _derivationNote.
